happy.description: Express joy, smiling OLED eyes and energetic posture

sad.description: Subdued mood with drooping eyes and lowered head

angry.description: Fierce expression with red alert glow and sharp eyebrows

sleepy.description: Closed eyes with slow breathing and power-saving posture

neutral.description: Default attentive posture with periodic natural blinking

surprised.description: Wide circular glowing eyes and raised head

confused.description: Asymmetrical eyes with curious tilted head

dance.description: Rhythmic groove routine using dual servos

nod.description: Pitch head up and down in affirmation

shake.description: Yaw head left and right in disagreement

look_left.description: Turn yaw servo towards the left

look_right.description: Turn yaw servo towards the right

look_center.description: Re-center both servos to neutral baseline

wiggle.description: Rapid oscillation showing excitement or joy

stop.description: Immediately halt all active servo routines

tell_joke.description: Tell a clean, funny robotics or tech joke

goodbye.description: Farewell message before idling or sleeping

tell_fact.description: Share an intriguing AI, science, or robotics fact

quiet_mode.description: Quiet conversational mode without loud audio chimes

show_time.description: Display current digital clock on OLED

show_date.description: Display current calendar date on OLED

show_datetime.description: Display combined time and date on OLED

show_temperature.description: Display ambient sensor temperature on OLED

show_distance.description: Display ultrasonic obstacle distance on OLED

check_environment.description: Comprehensive scan of all active sensors

status.description: Report comprehensive backend and hardware diagnostics

reset_expression.description: Restore OLED face and avatar expression to neutral

show_battery.description: Report current battery state of charge
